title: Time to save an old axe
titleZh: 为一件古老石斧争取时间
summaryZh: 一件约四千年前的石斧暂时不能出口，博物馆可以争取购买并向公众展示。

sentences.text: An old stone axe head from Scarthingwell is the subject of a new government decision.
sentences.zh: 一件来自Scarthingwell的古老石斧斧头成为政府一项新决定的对象。

sentences.text: It is about four thousand years old and comes from the Bronze Age.
sentences.zh: 它已有约四千年历史，来自青铜时代。

sentences.text: People found it during farm work in North Yorkshire in the winter of 1974.
sentences.zh: 1974年冬天，人们在北约克郡进行农活时发现了它。

sentences.text: The object is small: it is about twelve centimetres long and weighs about 360 grams.
sentences.zh: 这件器物很小：长约十二厘米，重约360克。

sentences.text: Its surface is smooth, and it is still in very good condition.
sentences.zh: 它的表面很光滑，保存状况仍然很好。

sentences.text: On 23 October 2026, the government announced a temporary stop to its export.
sentences.zh: 2026年10月23日，政府宣布暂时阻止它出口。

sentences.text: The aim is to give a British museum or another suitable institution time to buy it.
sentences.zh: 目的是给英国的博物馆或其他合适机构时间购买它。

sentences.text: They can try to raise money and keep the axe head in the country for public display.
sentences.zh: 这些机构可以设法筹款，把石斧留在英国向公众展示。

sentences.text: The first waiting period ends on 22 December 2026, and the recommended price is £15,000.
sentences.zh: 第一阶段的暂缓期到2026年12月22日结束，建议购买价为15,000英镑。

sentences.text: The announcement does not say that a museum has already bought the object.
sentences.zh: 这则公告没有说已有博物馆买下这件器物。

sentences.text: The axe head can help researchers study the skills and lives of people long ago.
sentences.zh: 这件石斧可以帮助研究人员了解很久以前人们的技艺与生活。

words.note: found是find的过去式，和1974年的发现事件对应。
smooth形容surface的质感，是光滑而不是粗糙、潮湿或黏的。
temporary表示暂时的，与有限的暂缓期一致。
raise money是筹款；此处不是花钱、退钱或数钱。
researchers为复数，指研究历史器物的人。

sentences.note: does not say that区分报道明确说出的事实与尚未发生的结果。

questions.text: Why might a museum need time before buying an old object?
questions.zh: 博物馆购买古物前为什么可能需要时间？

expressions.text: The decision gives people time to…
expressions.zh: 这项决定给人们时间去……
